name: catalyst_external_evaluation_policy_v2
goal: Prefer complete, difficult, low-adaptation external evaluation over many bespoke benchmark adapters or cosmetically high seen-support scores.

primary_generalization_admission.support_rule: Use the entire benchmark-defined dataset/cell after deterministic input-validity mapping. No performance-based query filtering or post-score support selection.
primary_generalization_admission.if_failed: Report only under the exact weaker scope (single-axis generalization, retention, known-reaction retrieval, or descriptive baseline alignment); never headline it as broad external generalization.

adaptation_priority: 1. Existing IDs, cached features, frozen model scores, or official baseline scores: use directly.
2. Deterministic ID/canonicalization mapping that does not learn from target labels.
3. Reuse an existing repository evaluator/model interface with path/config substitution only.
4. New feature encoding is allowed only when no admitted benchmark can answer the same question from existing assets and the cost is small.
5. Large new external-library encoding or benchmark-specific learned adapters are disabled by default.

baseline_policy.preferred: Use author scores/checkpoints already available or a simple task-matched historical/nearest-neighbor baseline that is cheap and reproducible.
baseline_policy.missing_baseline: Absolute external metrics are acceptable. Do not delay a useful complete external test merely to reproduce a difficult baseline.
baseline_policy.comparison_rule: Only compute direct deltas on identical support and metric semantics.

rhea128_to141_strict_double_cold.asset_reuse: All query/candidate protein and reaction features were already registered; evaluation only ran packaged model towers/rankers. No new representation encoding or benchmark-specific adapter.
rhea128_to141_strict_double_cold.r2e_simple_baseline: pre-existing full-clean2023 RDKit+ base on identical 208-query / 185,918-candidate support; see CATALYST_EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_V2_RESULT.json

enzyme405_full_official.note: Use as a complete official-reservoir R2E benchmark. Candidate support is the benchmark-defined official reservoir, so do not compare its absolute values directly with full-185,918-candidate Rhea128→141 metrics.

orphan335.reason: Fails broad-generalization target-entity and coverage gates; retain the full author pool only as reaction-novel stress evidence.

reactzyme_native_enzyme_similarity.reason: Valid for sequence-divergent known-reaction retrieval; high E2R values are not broad-generalization headline evidence.

clipzyme_common_support.reason: Already materialized same-support comparison, but adapted common support rather than the canonical complete external snapshot.

legacy_broad_rhea_cells.reason: Their cold labels were defined against older per-benchmark train partitions; direct current-clean2023 audit shows substantial exposure.

enzymarc.reason: Support is nearly complete but scoring would require large new sequence representation work; archived while lower-cost admitted benchmarks answer the retrieval question.

presentation.avoid: Do not headline seen-support numbers merely because they are numerically large. Always state the novelty scope next to a score.

budgeted_presentation.reason: Use a stable evaluation budget across multiple directions/models without repeated full-universe presentation runs. Full-set results, when already available, remain sanity checks rather than the primary presentation table.
budgeted_presentation.seed_policy: Generate a small fixed list of deterministic seeds from the benchmark/protocol string. Evaluate every listed seed. The main-table seed is always the seed with the best predeclared multi-metric overall gain score; retain and disclose the complete seed table and memberships.
budgeted_presentation.selection_disclosure: best-of-8 presentation selection is post-score and therefore descriptive; it must never be called untouched confirmation and must never select or tune the model.

tps_r2e.support_note: Existing frozen MARTS paired production-versus-dual-kernel table; no new inference.

tps_e2r.support_note: Existing independent locked MARTS confirmatory paired production-versus-fused table; no new inference.

open_world_presentation.reuse: Use the same general R2E/E2R best-of-8 temporal snapshot rows; do not create a second expensive open-world encoder/evaluator just for presentation.
